response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT f.zoneref, s.entrystat, f.traitcount FROM scanfeatures f JOIN sites s ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE f.traitcount > 489), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM matched) SELECT m.zoneref AS site_code, m.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(m.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / t.total_count AS share FROM matched m CROSS JOIN totals t GROUP BY m.zoneref, m.entrystat, t.total_count ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
